desc: Derive the non-crossing/removal structure and the rank-based upper-bound/attainability characterization.
Implement the \(O(N\log N)\) prefix/suffix heap algorithm with stdin/stdout handling and 64-bit-safe arithmetic.
Prove attainability for both even and odd \(N\) using balanced positive/negative labels and repeated adjacent opposite-label removal.
Run the provided sample tests and validate edge cases including equal values and \(N=2\).
